name: reflect
description: Notices when you correct Claude or state a preference, turns it into a one-line rule, and offers to save it for this project or for every project so the next session already knows.

enabled.title: Reflect
enabled.description: Offer to save rules learned from your corrections.

detect.title: What to look at
detect.description: auto checks prompts that read like a correction or a preference with one small model call each (the prompt and the end of Claude's last reply are sent to that model). explicit only takes prompts that start with remember:.

model.title: Model that words the rule
model.description: A model alias or id for the small call that decides whether a prompt holds a rule.
